timing.caches: none added: preparation is already done once per dataset by the caller (prepare_series / prepare_policy_series); per-evaluation time is milliseconds

data_preparation.description: load = adapters.load_site_file (JSON parse + contract validation of every sample); prepare = windows.prepare_series (sample-and-hold step functions), once per dataset
data_preparation.policy_pair_description: prepare_policy_series(malapert-massif): both sampling policies, once per dataset

evaluate_scenario.workload: 200 x 14-day missions at malapert-massif, landings every 37 h from 2027-01-01, standard lander, on the prepared series (full pipeline incl. explanations)

rank_assessments.workload: 50 x ranking of 24 assessments (one per site)

sampling_sensitivity_report.workload: 40 x 14-day missions at malapert-massif on the prepared policy pair (two full evaluations + comparison each)
